description:
Is soul sleep biblical? Does the Bible teach that a person's soul ceases to exist upon the death of the physical body? Seventh-day Adventist, Matt Morea, and Catholic Answers (@CA-Live) apologist, Joe Heschmeyer from the Shameless Popery Podcast (@shamelesspopery), debate what the Bible teaches about the state of man in death. Does man have a rational soul? What is the soul? What happens to a person's consciousness when they die?
